event.name: 19 January 2026 · G4 geomagnetic storm onset
event.description: The severe G4 phase first reached at 19:38 UTC on 19 January, as reported by NOAA SWPC. T0 marks this onset, not the storm peak.

observation_source: NASA SPDF hourly OMNI2 archive at Earth. Missing target values retained; Kp/Ap are archived three-hour indices, F10.7 is daily. Bt is the magnitude of the hourly mean GSM vector, matching model training. Retrospective revised observations, not original real-time L1 receipts.
input_source: NASA OMNI2 hours strictly before each issue. Current speed model uses its DLinear fallback without AIA. Scalar geomagnetic/radiation inputs are normalized within each historical cutoff; Kp/Ap are admitted after their 3-hour bins close, daily F10.7 after day end. Integer index conversion matches the operational input contract. IMF uses the model’s OMNI training feature definition, not the native-L1 adapter. Retrospective revised data do not reconstruct original receipts. Southward IMF requires GONG and is unavailable; S10/M10/Y10 have no installed forecast artifacts.
